ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by a dominant central low-intensity (black) region covering approximately 40% of the visible surface and lateral high-intensity (white) regions covering approximately 60%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity V-shaped anchor extending from the peduncle to the median notch. High-intensity lateral lobes featuring non-contiguous yellowish-brown mottling. Peripheral distribution of small low-intensity circular blobs along the trailing edge and tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 110 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge with peak-to-valley amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels. Distinctive jagged morphology at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curvature along the trailing edge extending from the distal tips to the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of small, dark, roughly circular pixel groups localized at the trailing edge serrations and distal tips. Sparse white punctate marks visible within the central dark pigmentation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions visible on the left high-intensity lobe, including a series of three parallel diagonal marks approximately 15-20 pixels in length.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular deep indentation on the trailing edge of the left distal tip, distinct from standard serration patterns.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive yellowish-tan bio-fouling/staining across the high-intensity regions of both lobes, primarily concentrated toward the lower leading edge.
